dsparkDescription: Dafay yebbi DSpark Q8_0 àndandoo ({{size}}) pour LFM2.5-2.6B. Mën na gaaw defar, waaye dafay jëfandikoo lu gëna RAM wala VRAM, bàyyi memory bu néew ngir contexte. Natt ko ci sa aparey; Defar guddaayu muy wax wala nga dindi dekodage speculatif ci jekkal model bi.
